title: JeffersonWM auth popup and home handoff checkpoint
content:
This checkpoint records the end-of-night pass where JeffersonWM Home and Auth were brought into a cleaner popup-first login flow. The broader goal is to keep the auth system present across the ecosystem without making it visually loud on every page.

What worked:

  • Compact popup auth: Auth now supports a popup=1 mode that renders as a small member-area card instead of a full page.
  • Home-page cleanup: JeffersonWM Home keeps only the essential bottom links and launches auth as a popup from Account.
  • Session-aware account link: the account page now flips between Login/Register and Sign Out depending on whether a session is active.

What changed:

  • Removed the old Login/Register links from the JeffersonWM home footer.
  • Added popup launch and message handling so the auth card can return control to the opener after sign-in.
  • Kept the account page visually simple so login, register, and sign-out all live behind one predictable entry point.

What this means next is that Auth can stay central in the architecture without needing to be visually prominent unless a site specifically asks for it.
